# @lenso/cache

> 标签: JavaScript

## 简介

Typed finite-TTL JSON caching. The ordinary service is independent of Lenso. `/memory`, `/redis` and `/plugin` are separate entries; the root entry imports neither Bun Redis nor Lenso, Auth, DB, Manage, Tasks, Log or OTel. Core is an optional peer used on
